name: Philology. Linguistics
solves: show that languages share a source, find the units of a language, and measure usage

tools.name: Comparative method
tools.does: reconstructs a parent language from regular correspondences
hypotheses: compared words are inherited, not borrowed

tools.name: Minimal pair test
tools.does: shows two sounds are distinct units
hypotheses: the words differ in one sound in the same position

tools.name: Constituency tests
tools.does: show which word groups act as units in a sentence

tools.name: Corpus frequency analysis
tools.does: counts forms and patterns in texts
hypotheses: the collection represents the variety studied
